arabic text: KHAIMOME AGH LAG GAI ZAINAB AKELI HAI
english translation text: THE TENTS ARE ON FIRE AND ZAINAB IS ALONE

arabic text: KHAIMOME AGH LAG GAI ZAINAB AKELI HAI\nEK DIN ME GAR UJAL GAYA AFAT YE JELI HAI
english translation text: THE TENTS ARE ON FIRE AND ZAINAB IS ALONE,\nIN ONE DAY HER WHOLE HOUSEHOLD HAS BEEN DESTROYED AND SHE HAS ENDURED ALL OF THIS

arabic text:
SHAME GHARIBA OR HAI KHAIME JALE HUE
EHLE HARAM HAI KHAK PE KAIDI BANE HUE
(BAITHE HAI EK MAKAM PE KAIDI LUTE HUE)
EK DIN ME GAR UJAL GAYA AFAT YE JELI HAI
english translation text: IT IS SHAM GHARIBA AND THE TENTS HAVE BEEN BURNT,\nTHE WOMEN OF THE AHLUL BAYT ARE SITTING ON THE SAND AND HAVE BEEN MADE PRISONERS

arabic text:
MUSHKIL KUSHA KI LADLI MUSHKIL ME AI HAI
DURRE LAGA RAHE HAI SITAMGAR DUHAI HAI
BE PARDA KAR DIYA HAI KAYAMAT NIBHAYI HAI
BABA TUMHE BULATI HAI ZAIBAB TANHAI HAI
english translation text: THE DAUGHTER OF MUSHKIL KUSHA ALI IS IN TROUBLE,\nTHE CRUEL MEN ARE WHIPPING HER, THEY HAVE SNATCHED HER VEIL, IT IS LIKE THE DAY OF JUDGEMENT,\nFATHER SHE IS CALLING YOU FOR ZAINAB IS ALONE

arabic text:
BABA HAMARE GHAR KO JALAYA LAINONE
PANI DIKHA DIKHA KE BAHAYA LAINONE
BIMARE KARBALAKO RULAYA LAINONE
ZAINAB KO SAR BAREHNA PHIRAYA LAINONE
english translation text: FATHER, THE WICKED PEOPLE HAVE BURNT OUR TENTS, THEY SHOWED US WATER AND THEN SPILT IT IN FRONT OF OUR EYES, THEY HAVE MADE SAJJAD WEEP, THEY HAVE PARADED ZAINAB WITHOUT HER VEIL

arabic text:
ASGHAR KO ROCHUKI ALI AKBER KO ROCHUKI
MAJAYE BHAI BETE PAYAMBER KO ROCHUKI
BAS INTEHA YE HAI KE BAHATAR KO ROCHUKI
ZAINAB TO FATEMA KE BHARE GAR KO ROCHUKI
english translation text:
ZAINAB HAS CRIED FOR ALI ASGHAR AND ALI AKBAR,
SHE HAS CRIED FOR HER BROTHER AND SONS,
SHE HAS CRIED FOR ALL THE 72 MARTYRS,
SHE HAS CRIED FOR FATIMA’S ENTIRE HOUSEHOLD

arabic text:
KAIDI BANARA HE HAI SITAMGHAR ME KYA KARU
TANHA HAI MERA ABIDE MUZTAR ME KYA KARU
AI FATEMA KE LADLE DILBAR ME KYA KARU
ZALIM PHIRA RAHE HAI KHULE SAR ME KYA KARU
english translation text: THE TYRANTS ARE MAKING US PRISONERS,\nWHAT SHALL I DO? MY SAJJAD IS ALL ALONE, WHAT SHALL I DO?\nO BELOVED SON OF ZAHRA, WHAT SHALL I DO? THE TYRANTS ARE PARADING US WITHOUT OUR VEILS, WHAT SHALL I DO?

arabic text:
MAKTAL SE AARI HAI SADAE YE BAR BAR
HAM SO RAHE HAI KHAKH PE TUM REHNA HOSHIYAR
AI FATEMA KE LADLI BHAI KI JANISAR
TUM KAFELEKI KAFELA SALAR SOGWAR
english translation text:
THIS VOICE IS HEARD FROM THE BATTLEFIELD,
WE ARE SLEEPING ON THE SAND, PLEASE BE VIGILANT,
O BELOVED DAUGHTER OF ZAHRA, AND HELPER OF HER BROTHER,
YOU ARE THE LEADER OF THE CARAVAN NOW
